It’s cut from a soft, cotton-silk blend that falls into a fluid, spacious silhouette suspended from adjustable straps. Style it with flat sandals for summer days and nights.

name: Slouch waist crinkled dress cream
body_html: TOTEME dress constructed from curved panels that create a slouching effect at the waist when sewn together. It is made from a crinkled viscose blend with cap sleeves and an ankle-grazing hem and fastens with a concealed back zipper. Pair it with heels or flats to attend a garden party.

name: Soft tuxedo skirt black
body_html: Skirt crafted from fluid viscose satin with effortless drape. The straight, knee-length silhouette channels tuxedo codes with angled side pockets and a double-faced satin hem that adds sculptural weight to its fluid movement.

name: Slouch waist dress bark
body_html: TOTEME dress constructed from curved panels that create a slouching effect at the waist when sewn together. Made from fluid crepe with a lustrous satin reverse, it has cap sleeves and a floor-grazing hem and fastens with a concealed back zipper. Add a clutch and heels to attend an opening night.

name: Flared jersey skirt chai
body_html: Ankle-length skirt crafted from fluid jersey for a soft drape. The silhouette falls gently from a fitted waist with a concealed back zip before opening to a subtle fullness at the hem.

name: V-neck jersey dress black
body_html: Cut from fluid jersey with an effortless drape, this dress has a V-neckline, short sleeves, and a softly defined waist that flows into a full ankle-length skirt. Wear with a drop necklace and flat sandals to complement the elongated silhouette.

name: Light wool skirt ecru
body_html: Designer’s note: "This long skirt was designed with a minimalist construction and a purist aesthetic. It's made from light and fluid tailoring wool and has a straight silhouette, low waistline and side-slit pockets. A back zipper and a generous hem slit add to its ease."

name: BUTTONED DRESS IN MERINO WOOL BLEND
body_html:
This dress is part of an evolving and modular wardrobe that reflects LEMAIRE’s interest in movement. Featuring buttoned panels, it is knitted in a merino wool blend with a hand that is both dry and supple.

The model is 177 cm tall and wears a size 36 (S).

name: Monogram silk dress washed black
tags: collection: New in,collection: Travel Garderob,collection:Garderob,collection:PF25,collection:Shop all,collection:women,color:washed black,custom:Garderob
body_html: Designer’s note: “This dress has the ease of nightwear but for an evening out. This barely-there slip dress is cut from washed silk with a soft hand feel and finished with a crochet-inspired version of our signature monogram.”

name: Long knit skirt black
body_html: TOTEME skirt finely knitted as a nod to the collection's play on transparency. It has a long, straight silhouette suspended from a wide elastic waistband that can be adjusted at the hips. Team it with a tank and slides for lunch.

name: Brushed cashmere gloves black
body_html: Designer's note: “These gloves are the kind of piece that finishes a winter look. They're knitted from soft cashmere and brushed for a fuzzy, cozy texture.”

name: FESSES CLUTCH IN PATINATED CALFSKIN
body_html: Born from a collaboration between LEMAIRE and artist Carlos Peñafiel, this series of accessories explores the dialogue between traditional craftsmanship and contemporary art. The Fesses clutch embodies LEMAIRE’s emblematic savoir-faire in sheathed leather goods. Crafted in patinated leather, it reveals an organic and sculptural shape inspired by the anatomy of the body. Its subtle nuances give each piece a unique character.

name: GEAR POCKET ORGANIZER IN LEATHER
body_html: An elegant accessory from the Gear line that completes the LEMAIRE wardrobe. Intended for daily use with an emphasis on comfort and simplicity, this pocket organizer is crafted in glossy vegetable-tanned leather from a certified tannery.

name: FORTUNE CROISSANT BAG IN LEATHER
body_html:
Inspired by the iconic Croissant line, the Fortune Croissant bag introduces a new silhouette for hand and shoulder carry. Its half-moon look is achieved through an assembly of topstitched panels, enriched by knotted elements.
The bag is crafted in soft, supple nappa lambskin leather, characterized by its smooth hand and natural shine, LWG Gold certified.

name: POCKET SCARF BAG IN SHINY NAPPA LAMBSKIN
body_html: Designed as a continuation of the silhouette, the Pocket Scarf Bag is rooted in LEMAIRE’s DNA, at the crossroads of ready-to-wear and leather goods. Its compact, supple silhouette extends the garment through a functional textile accessory. Evoking the shape of a scarf, it is crafted in nappa lambskin, a soft and supple material characterized by its smooth hand and shiny appearance.

name: MEDIUM CROISSANT BAG IN COATED COTTON
body_html:
The Croissant line is emblematic of the LEMAIRE wardrobe. This versatile, supple bag features a curve inspired by the Viennoiserie of the same name, created by a combination of topstitched panels and knotted elements.
This medium-sized bag is made of coated cotton canvas with a textured, shiny look.

name: T-lock pony hair clutch black
body_html: Sculptural clutch named for the signature T-lock closure. Made in Italy from pony hair-effect leather with refined lines and soft curves, it can be carried nestled in the hand or worn across the body using the detachable strap.

name: Medium belted paper raffia tote black
body_html: A new, mid-sized expression of the Belted tote. Crafted in handwoven paper raffia with tonal leather trim, it retains a generous silhouette, closing with a small clasp.

name: Clip palmellato-patent shoulder black
body_html: New for Fall Winter 26, the Clip shoulder is a play on the classic box bag, with the graphic geometric angles, distinctive dipped base and clipped edges of the original. Crafted in Italy from high shine palmellato leather with a zip closure.

name: EGG BAG IN MOLDED LEATHER
body_html:
The Egg bag embodies LEMAIRE's expertise in leather goods, featuring the molded leather technique. Made from LWG Silver-certified patinated leather, it is shaped without metal structures, guaranteeing a sculptural, yet lightweight effect.
This molded, waxed and hand-polished bag is a unique piece, sensitive to the roughness of the hand that makes it.
Ideal for everyday essentials, it can be carried by hand or cross-body.

name: T-lock croco-embossed top handle dark brown
body_html: Emblematic TOTEME bag named for the signature T-lock closure. Made in Italy from signature croco-embossed leather shaped with refined lines and soft curves, it nestles under the arm or can be carried by the top handle or the detachable and adjustable strap.

name: SOFT TAB STUDS DOTS BIFOLD WALLET IN LEATHER
body_html: The Soft Tab line offers an elegant design that complements the LEMAIRE wardrobe. Intended for daily use, this bifold wallet is crafted in grained buffalo leather with studs, a dense and resistant material with a textured aspect, from a certified tannery.

name: Small belted paper raffia tote natural
body_html: A new, smaller expression of the Belted tote. Crafted in handwoven paper raffia with contrasting leather trim, it retains a generous silhouette in petite proportions, closing with a small clasp.

name: T-lock ostrich-embossed shoulder bordeaux
body_html: An east-west iteration of the original T-lock top handle, named for its distinctive twist-lock closure. Crafted in Italy from ostrich-embossed leather, it has elongated proportions that nestle naturally under the shoulder.

name: Roam leather tote brown
body_html: Soft and unstructured tote seen on the Spring Summer 26 runway, with subtle geometric folds that create a gentle drape. Crafted in Italy from smooth bonded leather, the oversized north-south silhouette includes an interior pocket and double straps for hand or shoulder carry.

name: LARGE SOFT GAME BAG IN NYLON CANVAS
body_html:
Inspired by the iconic Croissant line, the Soft Game bag is emblematic for versatile wear.
Ideal for everyday use, it features embroidered eyelets and matching laces to tighten and adjust its volume.
This large, supple bag is made from quilted, water-repellent nylon canvas with a resistant, matte finish.

name: MEDIUM CROISSANT BAG IN LEATHER
body_html:
The Croissant line is emblematic of the LEMAIRE wardrobe. This versatile, supple bag features a curve inspired by the Viennoiserie of the same name, created by an assembly of topstitched panels and knotted elements.
This medium bag is crafted in nappa lamb leather, a soft, supple material characterized by its smooth hand and natural shine, certified LWG Gold.

name: Threefold croco-embossed clutch black
body_html: New Threefold clutch, crafted in croco-embossed leather with a three-gusset construction that creates dimensionality and structured volume. A top zipper finishes the sharp triangular silhouette to secure essentials.

name: MEDIUM GEAR BAG IN LEATHER
body_html:
Inspired by LEMAIRE's utilitarian spirit, the Gear line borrows codes and details from vintage tool bags, notably its signature flap closure with metal clip clasp. This bag is made from glossy vegetable-tanned leather, LWG Gold certified.
Featuring an adjustable shoulder strap and pockets, this medium bag is ideal for everyday use.

name: GEAR CARD HOLDER IN LEATHER
body_html: An elegant accessory from the Gear line that completes the LEMAIRE wardrobe. Ideal for daily use, this card holder is crafted in glossy vegetable-tanned leather from a certified tannery.

name: BELTED TOTE BAG IN HEAVY ECO COTTON CANVAS
body_html: The Belted line reinterprets archetypal shapes with a minimal and utilitarian spirit. It plays on contrasts through a vegetable-tanned leather shoulder strap inspired by a belt, and shiny metal elements. Designed to carry everyday essentials, this Tote Bag offers a look that is both practical and sharp. This bag is crafted in heavy cotton canvas with a patinated appearance.

name: Cashmere gloves black
body_html: Designer's note: "For these gloves we wanted a featherlight cashmere with a subtle rib, so they’re soft, warm, and easy to slip into your daily uniform. We like them layered with the matching beanie and neck warmer for a tonal, pulled-together look."

name: Belted leather bucket bag black
body_html: The Belted buckle bag debuted on the Fall Winter 24 runway, marking TOTEME's 10th anniversary. Crafted in Italy from softly textured Palmellato leather with gold-tone hardware, it features an elegant belt to cinch the flattened bucket silhouette or leave open for extra space, and is fitted with two internal slip pockets. Wear it in the city, suspended from the shoulder strap.

name: Medium grained-leather day tote black
body_html: Designer's note: "A more concise take on our Day tote, streamlined in scale and a sharper, more sculptural silhouette. Carry it by hand, over the shoulder, or cross-body."

name: SMALL CROISSANT BAG IN COATED COTTON
body_html:
The Croissant line is emblematic of the LEMAIRE wardrobe. This versatile, supple bag features a curve inspired by the viennoiserie of the same name, created by a combination of topstitched panels and knotted elements.
This small bag is made of coated cotton canvas with a textured, shiny look.

name: MINI SOFT GEAR BAG IN BUBBLE LAMBSKIN
body_html: Inspired by LEMAIRE’s utilitarian spirit, the Gear line borrows the codes and details of vintage tool bags, notably its signature closure: a flap with a metal clip clasp. This bag is crafted in bubble lambskin for a more supple version. Characterized by its adjustable shoulder strap and zipped closure, this mini bag is ideal for everyday use.

name: T-lock woven-leather top handle black
body_html: Emblematic TOTEME bag named for the signature T-lock closure. Made in Italy from supple handwoven leather with refined lines and soft curves, it nestles under the arm or can be carried by the top handle or the detachable and adjustable strap.

name: Clip canvas top handle beige/black
body_html: Classic box bag silhouette redefined with graphic geometric angles and the distinctive clipped edges that inspired its name. First seen on the Spring Summer 26 runway and crafted in Italy from natural canvas with a lizard-embossed leather trim, it features a press-lock closure on a short flap and a back slide pocket. Carry it left open by the top handle to balance refined shape, or by the detachable shoulder strap.

name: QUIVER CLIP BAG IN LEATHER
body_html: The unisex Quiver Clip line is inspired by the traditional quiver and is suitable for day and night use. Worn on the shoulder or crossbody, this bag features a vegetable-tanned leather shoulder strap, adjustable with a snap hook, a new metal piece specially designed by the company's accessories studio. Crafted in grained buffalo leather, a thick, resistant material characterized by its textured appearance and LWG Gold certified, this utilitarian bag hugs the body, an attitude essential to the DNA of LEMAIRE accessories.

name: LARGE QUIVER CLIP BAG IN LEATHER
body_html: The unisex Quiver Clip line is inspired by the traditional quiver and adapts from day to night. Worn on the shoulder or crossbody, this new size L format features a vegetable-tanned leather strap adjustable with a carabiner, a metal piece specially developed by the accessories studio. Crafted in grained buffalo leather, a dense and resistant material from a certified tannery, this utilitarian bag hugs the body, an attitude essential to LEMAIRE accessories.

name: SMALL BELTED TOTE BAG IN HEAVY ECO COTTON CANVAS
body_html: The Belted line reinterprets archetypal shapes with a minimal and utilitarian spirit. It plays on contrasts through a vegetable-tanned leather shoulder strap inspired by a belt, and shiny metal elements. Designed to carry everyday essentials, this Tote Bag offers a look that is both practical and sharp. This small bag is crafted in heavy cotton canvas with a patinated appearance.

name: T-lock leather clutch champagne
body_html: Sculptural clutch named for the signature T-lock closure. Made in Italy from pamellato leather with refined lines and soft curves, it can be carried nestled in the hand or worn across the body using the detachable strap.

name: RIO STUDS BELT 20 MM IN LEATHER
body_html: This belt embellished with decorative studs is a LEMAIRE wardrobe essential. Crafted in vegetable-tanned leather from a certified tannery, a dense and resistant material with a textured aspect, and finished with a strap-and-buckle closure.

name: Belted suede tote espresso
tags: collection: New in,collection: New in FW23,collection:FW23,collection:Shop all,collection:women,color:Espresso,japan_localization,ometria-list-id:19311
body_html:
TOTEME tote bag crafted in Italy from light and supple suede that drapes naturally next to the body. It has an adjustable strap with a silver-tone metal buckle matching the Slim trouser leather belt and opens with a small clasp to a resin-coated interior with two pockets. 

Please note that this piece is crafted from dyed suede, which is naturally prone to color transfer when rubbed against light-colored garments or exposed to water.

name: Square sunglasses black
body_html: TOTEME sunglasses made in Italy with a squared acetate frame that's softened along the edges. The grey-tinted lenses offer UV protection and can be replaced with prescription lenses, while the arms are accented with a silver-tone monogram plaque. Style them with city and vacation edits.

name: Slip jersey ballerinas grey melange
body_html: Light and tactile ballerinas crafted in Italy from soft jersey that follows the natural shape of the foot for effortless ease. Designed to slip on or carry anywhere.

name: ANATOMIC BOOTS WITH 55MM HEEL
body_html: The Anatomic line is emblematic of the LEMAIRE wardrobe, characterized by its rounded toe and nappa leather insoles. Lightweight and ergonomic, they emphasize ease of movement. This pair of heeled booties is crafted in LWG Gold-certified, glossy vegetable-tanned leather. We recommend a size up

name: Platform suede sandals black/tan
body_html: A new platform sandal made in Italy from supple suede, shaped with an ankle strap and a clean, sculptural silhouette. Style it with fluid evening pieces.

name: SOFT RUNNER IN SUEDE LEATHER
body_html: Inspired by vintage running sneakers, these rubber-soled runners are lightweight, making them an ideal pair for everyday wear. Stitched and padded panels evoke the characteristic details of leather goods. This model is made from warm, textured hand-sueded lambskin leather, LWG Gold certified.

name: Slip naplack ballerinas black
body_html: Light, tactile ballerina flats crafted in Italy from glossy naplack, shaped to follow the natural curve of the foot and finished with cushioned, flexible soles. Wear them day to night and slip them into your bag for travel.

name: Soft nappa ankle boots black
body_html: These ankle boots are crafted in Italy from soft, unlined nappa leather for a collapsible, glove-like fit. They have a minimalist mid-heel silhouette with clean lines and fasten with an easy back zipper.

name: 80 MM GLOVE SLINGBACK PUMPS IN SHADED LAMBSKIN
body_html: Inspired by the suppleness of a glove, the Glove line offers a feminine and confident silhouette. This pair of slingback pumps is crafted in lambskin with a shaded appearance and natural shine.

name: Croco-embossed heeled flip flops black
body_html: Designer’s note: “The leather flip flops have been a TOTEME icon for years and we've included them in our Garderob curation in croco-embossed leather as a versatile accessory that can be easily dressed up and down. Wear them to soften a summer dress or to instill a directional edge into sharp tailoring."

name: OUTDOOR SLIPPERS IN LEATHER
body_html: Inspired by indoor slippers, this pair is crafted from lined nappa lambskin for added comfort. Reimagined with a minimalist and contemporary look, it preserves the softness and flexibility of a home shoe, reinterpreted for outdoor use.

name: 55 MM PEDILLE HEELED BALLERINAS IN GOAT LEATHER
body_html: Inspired by dance shoes, the Pedille line is distinguished by a supple construction that sits close to the foot, evoking a slipper with a light and refined silhouette. This pair of heeled ballerinas is crafted in goat leather with a natural shine.

name: Velvet venetian slippers saffron
body_html: Designer’s note: “Our take on the timeless Venetian slippers, these indoor shoes embody the effortlessly dressed spirit of the TOTEME Garderob curation through an elongated silhouette accented with monochrome piping. Updated in a lively saffron tone, they comfortably hug the foot with soft velvet lined in leather. We like wearing them to entertain guests or travel.”

name: FLAT PEDILLE BALLERINAS IN GOAT LEATHER
body_html: Inspired by dance shoes, the Pedille line is distinguished by a supple construction that sits close to the foot, evoking a slipper with a light and refined silhouette. This pair of flat ballerinas is crafted in goat leather with a natural shine.

name: T-strap nappa sandals desert/dark brown
body_html: Purist sandals traced with a barely there, buckled T-bar strap made from supple nappa leather that matches the padded insole.

name: Slingback satin mary janes black
body_html: Slingback flats crafted in Italy from lustrous silk satin. The low-cut, minimal Mary Jane silhouette features a bold back strap and a delicate cross-strap detail.

name: 55 MM PEDILLE HEELED BALLERINAS IN GOAT LEATHER
body_html: Inspired by dance shoes, the Pedille line is distinguished by a supple construction that sits close to the foot, evoking a slipper with a light and refined silhouette. This pair of heeled ballerinas is crafted in goat leather with a natural shine.

name: 55 MM GLOVE SLINGBACK PUMPS IN SUPPLE LAMBSKIN
body_html: Inspired by the suppleness of a glove, the Glove line offers a feminine and confident silhouette. This pair of slingback pumps is crafted in lambskin, a supple material with a soft hand.

name: Slim lizard-embossed bandeau slides brown
body_html: A refined slide sandal traced by a slim bandeau strap. Crafted in Italy from lizard-embossed leather, it can be easily dressed up or down.

name: Flex sneakers desert/buttercup
body_html: Lace-up sneakers crafted from unlined nylon for a flexible, lightweight feel. Designed to a low profile, with tonal topstitching and suede trim around the toes, laces and back ankle tab. Wear them on the weekend or as a grounded finish to relaxed tailoring.

name: SOURIS FLAT CLASSIC DERBIES IN LEATHER
body_html:
Inspired by flamenco dance slippers, the emblematic Souris line features an upper and tongue made from a single piece of leather folded in on itself.
These flat derbies are crafted in LWG Gold-certified washed nappa lambskin leather, a soft, supple material characterized by its slightly patinated appearance.

name: PIPED CREPE SLIPPERS IN LEATHER
body_html: These slippers are iconic accessories from LEMAIRE’s footwear family. Their shape has a simple construction composed of two pieces of grained cow leather that are sewn together on the front and sealed with leather piping. A square toe and a leather sole add to their flexibility while a shiny finish elevates the slippers towards delicate elegance. They feature stitching and piping details as well.

name: Sport sneakers black
body_html: Our classic Sport sneakers return in a minimalist tone-on-tone combination for the new season. They have recycled polyamide and suede panels complete with moisture-wicking terry lining and an anti-slip rubber sole. Wear them throughout the week with trousers and jeans.

name: FLAT PEDILLE BALLERINAS IN GOAT LEATHER
body_html: Inspired by dance shoes, the Pedille line is distinguished by a supple construction that sits close to the foot, evoking a slipper with a light and refined silhouette. This pair of flat ballerinas is crafted in goat leather with a natural shine.

name: Classic leather slingbacks black
body_html: Designer’s note: ”These are a modern interpretation of classic pumps, with bold slingback straps and a contoured heel. For Garderob, we imagined them in smooth Nappa leather to complement minimalist looks. Tuck them into your jeans for directional styling."

name: Slim lizard-embossed bandeau mules brown
body_html: A refined mule sandal traced by a slim bandeau strap and balanced on a dainty kitten heel. Crafted in Italy from lizard-embossed leather, it brings a graphic edge to summer tailoring.

name: 80 MM GLOVE HEELED ANKLE BOOTS IN LAMINATED TEXTURED LEATHER
body_html: Inspired by the suppleness of a glove, the Glove line offers a feminine and assertive silhouette. This pair of high-heeled ankle boots is crafted in textured leather, worked to evoke a short-hair leather effect, then laminated to reveal a shiny, nuanced surface. It combines visual richness with a second-skin feel, in a register that is both surrealist and animal-inspired.

name: SOFT RUNNER IN LEATHER
body_html: Inspired by vintage running sneakers, these rubber-soled runners are lightweight, making them an ideal pair for everyday wear. Stitched and padded panels evoke the characteristic details of leather goods. This model is made from LWG Gold-certified nappa lamb leather, a soft, supple material characterized by its smooth feel and shiny appearance.

name: SOFT RUNNERS IN SUEDE LEATHER
body_html: Inspired by vintage running shoes, these rubber-soled runners are lightweight for everyday use. Quilted and topstitched cut-outs echo leather goods details. Crafted in nappa suede and Nylon from a certified tannery, a soft material with a smooth hand and gentle sheen.

name: SOFT RUNNERS IN SUEDE LEATHER
body_html: Inspired by vintage running shoes, these rubber-soled runners are lightweight for everyday use. Quilted and topstitched cut-outs echo leather goods details. Crafted in nappa suede and Nylon from a certified tannery, a soft material with a smooth hand and gentle sheen.

name: ZIPPED ANKLE BOOTS IN SHINY LEATHER
body_html: Inspired by the world of formal footwear, this pair of ankle boots features a structured construction. It is crafted in smooth vegetable-tanned leather with a shiny finish.

name: Petite signature hoops silver
body_html: Signature huggie hoops reimagined with slightly smaller proportions from rhodium-plated brass, offering an elevated twist on everyday pieces. Expertly crafted in Italy, they feature a bold frame that forms a modern oval shape when viewed in profile.

name: TWISTED CHAIN BRACELET IN RHODIUM-PLATED SILVER
body_html: This unisex silver line combines twisted chains of varying sizes, bringing a luminous and refined touch to the silhouette.

name: GARMENT ORNAMENT AND NECKLACE IN BRASS
body_html: Part of an evolving and modular wardrobe, this piece introduces new functions and ways of wearing, for example through a buttonhole, a belt loop or as a necklace. Composed of five agates, it reflects the house’s interest in cabinets of curiosities.

name: SCARF ORNAMENT IN BRASS
body_html: This scarf ornament is conceived as a modular detail, allowing the silhouette to be personalized while bringing a poetic touch to the everyday wardrobe.

name: FEATHER EARRINGS
body_html: This pair of earrings is made from meticulously dyed ostrich feathers and silver-plated brass. Entirely handmade in France, this exceptional piece was revealed on the FW25 catwalk.

name: BLOWN GLASS EARRING
body_html: This single earring is distinguished by an artisanal blown glass bead made in Lille. Each piece reflects delicate craftsmanship and reveals variations in shape and shade.

name: Signature collar gold
body_html: The Signature collar is part of a foundational TOTEME jewelry collection conceived to be mixed and matched as well as complemented with pieces you already own. It's crafted in Italy from hard-wearing 18kt gold-plated brass to a hinged silhouette that makes a satisfying clicking sound as you close it.

name: DOT EARRING WITH ONYX AND ROOSTER FEATHER
body_html: The Dot line is a refined jewellery collection inspired by balance and movement. Delicate spheres in semi-precious stones worn on the ears or around the neck; the minimalist earrings are crafted in sterling silver, while the choker is made in brass, offering a subtle contrast of material and finish. This variation introduces small rooster feathers paired with the stones, adding a gentle touch of colour and poetic movement.

name: CLOVE NECKLACE
body_html: Inspired by the delicate shape of cloves, this pendant necklace is crafted from hammered and patinated brass, a unique finish with a shiny, aged effect. This jewelry, with its raw, handcrafted touch, is equally suited to everyday wear or an elegant alternative for evening.

name: Signature collar silver
body_html: The Signature collar from the foundational TOTEME jewelry collection is reimagined in silver-tone rhodium-plated brass, offering an elevated twist on everyday pieces. It is crafted in Italy with a hinged silhouette that sits just above the collarbone.

name: CARLOS SHELL KEY RING IN LEATHER
body_html: The result of a collaboration between LEMAIRE and artist Carlos Peñafiel, this series of accessories explores the dialogue between traditional craftsmanship and contemporary art. It investigates the technique of moulded and patinated vegetable-tanned leather and the pursuit of organic shapes. Each piece is made by pressing certified-tannery leather onto a dedicated mould, then hand-shaped and sun-dried by artisans. Produced in limited edition, this shell-shaped key holder with carabiner is crafted through a meticulous artisanal process.

name: Petite signature hoops beige/gold
body_html: Signature huggie hoops are reimagined in resin treated for a marbled horn effect, offering an elevated twist on everyday pieces. Expertly crafted in Italy, they feature a bold frame that forms a modern oval shape when viewed in profile.

name: CASTANET MIROR
body_html: Inspired by the spirit of the cabinet of curiosities, this necklace with castanets walks a fine line between object and jewelry, a boundary LEMAIRE holds dear.

name: CURVED MINI DROP EARRINGS IN VERMEIL
body_html: The Drop line is emblematic of the LEMAIRE wardrobe. This pair of small curved drop-shaped signature earrings is crafted in vermeil.

name: Signature bracelet silver/gold
body_html: The Signature bracelet from the foundational TOTEME jewelry collection is updated in a distinctive colorblock, combining silver and gold tones. Crafted in Italy from recycled brass with rhodium and 24kt gold plating, its hinged silhouette sits comfortably on the wrist.

name: Rope lariat silver
body_html: Lariat necklace in rhodium-plated recycled brass with a sculptural knot inspired by maritime ropes. Artfully constructed, it drapes elegantly around the neckline with an adjustable length for versatile styling.

name: Signature stripe hoops black/gold
body_html: An evolution of the Signature huggie hoops, defined by a graphic black line in enamel through the center and an asymmetric oval silhouette. Handcrafted in Italy from 24kt gold-plated brass with a hinged closure.

name: SHORT DROP EARRINGS IN SILVER
body_html: The Drop line is emblematic of the LEMAIRE wardrobe. This pair of signature drop earrings is crafted in rhodium-plated silver.

name: Long faux pearl necklace white
body_html: TOTEME necklace featuring a white faux pearl pendant with a vertical, mirrored shape. Made in Italy, it has a long and fine grumette chain that fastens with a lobster clasp to two different lengths.

name: Medium tiger's eye drop necklace honey/gold
all_tags: product-family: medium tiger's eye drop necklace
body_html: Necklace crafted in Italy from recycled 24kt yellow gold-plated brass, finished with a tiger's eye drop pendant set with a cubic Swarovski crystal that sways gently as you move.

name: MICRO DROP EARRINGS IN SILVER
body_html: The Drop line is emblematic of the LEMAIRE wardrobe. This small drop-shaped signature earring is crafted in rhodium-plated silver.

name: Large onyx drop necklace black/gold
body_html: Seen throughout the Summer 25 runway collection unveiled in New York, this TOTEME necklace is conceived as a fluid contrast to the architectural ready-to-wear pieces. Made in Italy, it consists of a fine Y-shaped chain made from brass plated with recycled 24kt yellow gold and has a large drop pendant carved out of black onyx and set with a Swarovski crystal – bringing a delicate softness to the semi-precious stone. Watch it sway organically as you move – a subtle nod to the collection's bohemian theme.

name: AUBOCK MAGNIFYING GLASS NECKLACE
body_html: The result of a collaboration between LEMAIRE and Austrian designer Carl Auböck, this series of accessories explores the dialogue between traditional craftsmanship and contemporary design. Inspired by the spirit of the cabinet of curiosities, this necklace blurs the line between object and jewelry, a frontier dear to LEMAIRE. Each piece is unique: the horn features variations in color and pattern, which highlight its authentic, organic nature. These irregularities are not flaws but rather the mark of a living material, shaped by skilled hands. A true functional artwork—both decorative and practical.

name: FUZZY ROSE BROOCH IN LAMBSKIN SHEARLING
body_html: Designed as a hybrid object, this floral brooch plays on the boundary between ornament and object, bringing a tactile and poetic touch to the silhouette.

name: PERSONAL BRUSH NECKLACE
body_html: Inspired by the spirit of the cabinet de curiosité, this necklace with personal brush pendant stands between object and jewelry, a boundary dear to LEMAIRE.

name: RATTLE BOLO TIE
body_html: Inspired by the world of piercing, the Rattle line is emblematic of the LEMAIRE wardrobe. This modular Rattle Bolo Tie necklace in silver-plated brass borrows the codes of the western tie.

name: THISTLE NECKLACE
body_html: The Thistle line is a new proposal in fashion jewellery introduced for Spring-Summer 2026. LEMAIRE draws on the delicate form of a thistle, reimagined as a metal pin. The line also offers styling possibilities to fasten a knit cardigan or to adorn a garment.

name: MINI DROP EARRING IN SILVER
body_html: The Drop line is emblematic of the LEMAIRE wardrobe. This small drop-shaped signature earring is crafted in rhodium-plated silver.

name: Fine silk scarf collar ecru/black/silver
body_html: The signature TOTEME silk scarf is reimagined as a collar, detailed with fixed rhodium-tone rings and a delicate chain secured with a discrete clasp. The knotted ends are designed to fall loosely in front or to the side.

name: Signature ring gold
body_html: TOTEME Signature ring embodying the graphic codes, classic expression and effortless appeal of our ready-to-wear. It's crafted in Italy from 18kt gold-plated brass and durable palladium to a strong silhouette that varies in thickness along the circumference and is tumbled for a pre-loved look.
